Leading in health & well-being delivery solutions

We are the global go-to partner for drug packaging and drug delivery systems with a broad product range for pharma, health, well-being and biotech. We bring every type of medication safely, reliably and conveniently to or in the patient.

On the following pages we have compiled information about us. Starting with a detailed page about who we are, our portal for the press, followed by our worldwide activities, up to our investor relations activities.
